newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rikadenki Kogyo suspended from OTC trade.
newsitem.headline: Rikadenki Kogyo suspended from OTC trade.

text.p: Shares of Rikadenki Kogyo Co Ltd were suspended from trade in the over-the-counter (OTC) market on Wednesday afternoon, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association said.
An official of the association said trade in Rikadenki's shares was suspended in order to confirm the details of a report by private research company Teikoku Databank.
Teikoku said on Wednesday that Rikadenki had failed to honour promissory notes for the first time last Friday.
Rikadenki, which makes various measurement instruments, was not immediately available for comment.
Teikoku said that Rikadenki has been facing a tough time due to falling product prices, shrinking orders and severe competition.
The company has tried to improve its business by cutting its workforce and diversifying into new fields, but its interest burden and investment for expansion has squeezed its business, Teikoku said.
The company's debts totalled 1.81 billion yen as of September 30, 1996, Teikoku said.
